assumptions: change sets apply to the baseline they were authored against (docs/scope/lean-slice.md)

decisions.reason: Design and impact analysis identical to SCN-B; approved to apply in isolated workspace (fault-injection run).

limitations: metrics are demonstration data from a single workstation

plan_and_rationale.approach: FAULT-INJECTION DEMONSTRATION (FR-ORC-036): aliases as in the normal change set, plus a defect that removes collision retry for generated codes.

trade_offs: deterministic rule-based agents apply human-locked change sets instead of generating code at run time
scenario runs evaluate SEC-003 against a pinned pip-audit snapshot (no network); the live audit runs in `orch release check`
releases are local (snapshot or local staging); merging into the repository stays a manual human action
why: test failed (tests_failed: tests.shortener.test_api::test_code_collisions_retry_then_give_up_after_five); ROLLBACK before promotion: the isolated workspace was discarded, nothing was promoted, the last known-good release is unchanged
